what: Color panels (folders) stick 63px from the top of the screen and stack, overlapping the previous panel by 110px each. The moment the next panel’s head touches just below the previous panel’s head (next panel position − stick position − previous panel head height), the previous panel is released from sticky and left standing in place, so the previous panel does not stay buried but exits upward together with the next panel. The last panel is released at the bottom end of the group. There is no motion curve, just as much movement as the scroll

options.--fx-overlap: Height overlapping the front panel (css), default 110px
options.[data-fx-part=head]: Panel header (tab row) — when the next panel touches below it, the previous panel is released. 0 if none

from.where: index.html .top__bg > .folder — original FolderStack (sticky top 63px · overlap 110px, phone 46px · 60px)

note: Based on window scroll (not used in in-app scroll panels)
